section.div: Agentic AI with LangGraph enables autonomous AI agents that can reason, plan, remember context, use tools, and make decisions to accomplish complex tasks. LangGraph provides a graph-based orchestration framework for building reliable, multi-step AI workflows with state management, human oversight, and dynamic execution for real-world applications.

A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot built with Streamlit, LangChain, FAISS, and Groq Llama-3. Users can upload a PDF document and ask questions about its content. The system retrieves relevant text chunks using vector search and generates accurate answers using an LLM.
